summary: The Moz2D image library gained full CMYK support and a performance overhaul for color swizzling (converting image channel orders). CMYK and inverted CMYK were added to surface formats, and swizzling now uses SIMD-optimized paths (NEON, SSE2, SSSE3, AVX2) with fallbacks—plus extra hardening of buffer size checks. This yields faster, more correct color conversions for images (important for printers and some photo formats) and reduces crash or corruption risks.
